name: Bloodline
description: A dramatic thriller that explores the demons lurking beneath the surface of a contemporary American family. The Rayburns are hard-working pillars of their Florida Keys community. But when the black sheep son comes home for the 45th anniversary of his parents' hotel, he threatens to expose the Rayburns' dark secrets and shameful past, pushing his siblings to the limits of family loyalty.

videos.title: Part 1
videos.overview: Trouble starts when oldest son Danny Rayburn comes home for the 45th anniversary celebration of his parents' hotel in the Florida Keys' Islamorada.

videos.title: Part 2
videos.overview: An accident exposes old wounds, complicating the already difficult situation between Danny and his family.

videos.title: Part 3
videos.overview: With Robert’s condition uncertain, Danny re-considers staying in Islamorada. Meg’s personal and professional obligations become overwhelming.

videos.title: Part 4
videos.overview: The family adjusts to Danny’s new role at the inn. John and Marco discover a burned boat connected to their murder case.

videos.title: Part 5
videos.overview: A sudden tragedy unsettles the Rayburn clan. While searching for evidence in his case, John finds something disturbing from the family’s past.

videos.title: Part 6
videos.overview: John wants to keep Danny in the fold, but Danny learns an awful truth about the past. Meg takes on a new client. Kevin's personal life takes a turn.

videos.title: Part 7
videos.overview: John and Marco get a lead in their investigation. Meg does her best to help Carlos. Kevin comes clean with Danny.

videos.title: Part 8
videos.overview: Kevin recovers at Sally's house after he's robbed. Danny makes a deal with Carlos. John and Marco identify one of the murdered girls.

videos.title: Part 9
videos.overview: The DEA gets involved in John's murder case. Tensions rise between Meg and Danny. John digs into Danny's past. Sally reminisces.

videos.title: Part 10
videos.overview: As Meg and Sally move forward with the wedding plans, John and Marco's investigation points them in Danny's direction.

videos.title: Part 11
videos.overview: After John confronts Carlos about Danny’s illicit behavior, John, Kevin and Meg figure out a plan to save the family.

videos.title: Part 12
videos.overview: Danny’s past and present troubles became a threat to the Rayburns. Sally confronts her family.

videos.title: Part 13
videos.overview: John, Kevin and Meg try to get their lives back in order as the family comes to grips with the truth about Danny.

videos.title: Part 14
videos.overview: Meg learns her father kept a secret from the family for years. A voice from the past threatens John's plan to frame Wayne Lowry.

videos.title: Part 15
videos.overview: John decides to run for sheriff. While meeting with a business prospect, Kevin finds an unexpected moneymaking opportunity. Sally learns about Nolan.

videos.title: Part 16
videos.overview: Kevin's first transaction goes smoothly; his second is a disaster. John hunts for Eric in order to force Lowry to propose a plea deal to the police.

videos.title: Part 17
videos.overview: Kevin's actions loosen John's hold on Lowry. Sally gets a visitor from her past. John decides whether to help or hinder a bust on Lowry's operations.

videos.title: Part 18
videos.overview: Danny's old partner in crime in Miami is determined to make the Rayburns pay. Investor Roy Gilbert agrees to fund John's campaign, on one condition.

videos.title: Part 19
videos.overview: Eve reveals family secrets to Janey. Ozzy continues to provoke John. Meg finds a link between Aguirre's shady past and someone close to her.

videos.title: Part 20
videos.overview: At Aguirre's insistence, Marco questions Kevin and Meg about the time frame following the Red Reef Inn murder. Diana comes to a horrible realization.

videos.title: Part 21
videos.overview: Kevin finds a possible solution to his financial problems. Marco checks up on Meg's explanation for her suspicious behavior. Sally makes Eve an offer.

videos.title: Part 22
videos.overview: John finds evidence that refutes his alibi. Eric makes a remark that catches Marco's attention. Meg must decide whom to protect: Marco or her family.

videos.title: Part 23
videos.overview: Marco scrambles to get Eric immunity. Nolan recalls meeting Robert. Meg and Kevin turn against John, who pursues the one man who can alter his fate.

videos.title: Part 24
videos.overview: While fleeing the Keys, John hits a roadblock. In the wake of his confessional meeting with Marco, Kevin is forced to get help from a shady character.

videos.title: Part 25
videos.overview: Kevin finally reaches John on his phone. Eric calls Ozzy about an opportunity. Things go wrong while Kevin and Roy's man set up a plausible scenario.

videos.title: Part 26
videos.overview: Kevin's account of his injury gives Aguirre more questions than answers. Searching alone, John tries to find Eric before the police or Roy's men do.

videos.title: Part 27
videos.overview: Kevin and Belle become parents. John grows suspicious when Roy asks Kevin to sign a letter supporting Eric's petition to attend his mother's funeral.

videos.title: Part 28
videos.overview: While the Rayburns try to persuade the Diazes to accept a plea deal, Eric is advised to reconsider going to trial. Kevin falls in with a bad crowd.

videos.title: Part 29
videos.overview: On the day John testifies in court, he's visited by someone from his past. After catching John in a lie, Chelsea approaches the legal team with info.

videos.title: Part 30
videos.overview: Kevin takes the witness stand. John tracks down Meg. Sally agrees to testify against allegations that her family has a history of covering the truth.

videos.title: Part 31
videos.overview: Kevin finds himself in over his head with the Cubans. Sally makes plans for the future of the inn. John grows wary when a retired cop buddy visits.

videos.title: Part 32
videos.overview: A disoriented John finds himself in the hospital and proceeds to experience a series of surreal encounters that meld the past with the present.

videos.title: Part 33
videos.overview: Kevin learns one of the Cubans isn't who he claims to be. Sally gets devastating news. John faces what he must do to put the matter of Danny to rest.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 5 wins & 18 nominations total
